name: Flash3D
aliases: Flash3D — A method that uses a feed-forward network (FFN) for monocular reconstruction, generating 3DGS scenes by estimating depth from a single view.
definition: A method that uses a feed-forward network (FFN) for monocular reconstruction, generating 3DGS scenes by estimating depth from a single view.
summary: Flash3D is a fast, feed-forward network that reconstructs 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from a single image by estimating depth, distinguishing itself from multi-view methods.
